ENHTIM Exported Functions

group ENHTIM_Exported_Functions

Functions

void ENHTIM_Init(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, ENHTIM_InitTypeDef *ENHTIM_TimeBaseInitStruct)

Initialize the ENHTIMx unit peripheral according to the specified parameters in ENHTIM_InitStruct.

Example usage 

void driver_enhance_timer_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_TIMER, APBPeriph_TIMER_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ENHTIM_InitTypeDef ENHTIM_InitStruct;
    ENHTIM_StructInit(&ENHTIM_InitStruct);

    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_PWM_En = PWM_DISABLE;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Period = 1000000 - 1 ;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Mode = ENHTIM_Mode_UserDefine;
    ENHTIM_Init(ENHTIMER_NUM, &ENHTIM_InitStruct);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • ENHTIM_TimeBaseInitStruct -- [in] Pointer to a ENHTIM_InitTypeDef structure which will be initialized.

void ENHTIM_StructInit(ENHTIM_InitTypeDef *ENHTIM_InitStruct)

Fill each ENHTIM_InitStruct member with its default value.

Example usage 

void driver_enhance_timer_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_ENHTIMER, APBPeriph_ENHTIMER_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ENHTIM_InitTypeDef ENHTIM_InitStruct;
    ENHTIM_StructInit(&ENHTIM_InitStruct);

    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_PWM_En = PWM_DISABLE;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Period = 1000000 - 1;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Mode = ENHTIM_Mode_UserDefine;
    ENHTIM_Init(ENH_TIM0, &ENHTIM_InitStruct);
}

Note

void ENHTIM_Cmd(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified ENHTIMx peripheral.

Example usage 

void driver_enhance_timer_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_ENHTIMER, APBPeriph_ENHTIMER_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ENHTIM_InitTypeDef ENHTIM_InitStruct;
    ENHTIM_StructInit(&ENHTIM_InitStruct);

    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_PWM_En = PWM_DISABLE;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Period = 1000000 - 1;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Mode = ENHTIM_Mode_UserDefine;
    ENHTIM_Init(ENH_TIM0, &ENHTIM_InitStruct);
    ENHTIM_Cmd(ENH_TIM0, ENABLE);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the ENHTIMx peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Count start.

    • DISABLE: Count stop and clear count value.

void ENHTIM_INTConfig(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint8_t ENHTIM_INT, FunctionalState NewState)

Enable or disable the specified ENHTIMx interrupt.

Example usage 

void driver_enhance_timer_init(void)
{
    RCC_PeriphClockCmd(APBPeriph_TIMER, APBPeriph_TIMER_CLOCK, ENABLE);

    ENHTIM_InitTypeDef ENHTIM_InitStruct;
    ENHTIM_StructInit(&ENHTIM_InitStruct);

    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_PWM_En = PWM_DISABLE;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Period = 1000000 - 1;
    ENHTIM_InitStruct.ENHTIM_Mode = ENHTIM_Mode_UserDefine;
    ENHTIM_Init(ENH_TIM0, &ENHTIM_InitStruct);
    ENHTIM_ClearINT(ENH_TIM0);
    ENHTIM_INTConfig(ENH_TIM0, ENABLE);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the specified ENHTIMx peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • ENHTIM_INT -- [in] Specify the ENHTIMx interrupt source which to be enabled or disabled. Refer to ENHTIM Interrupts.

  • NewState -- [in] New state of the ENHTIMx peripheral. This parameter can be one of the following values:

    • ENABLE: Enable the specified interrupt.

    • DISABLE: Disable the specified interrupt.

ITStatus ENHTIM_GetINTStatus(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint8_t ENHTIM_INT)

Get the specified ENHTIMx interrupt status.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    ENHTIM_GetINTStatus(ENH_TIM0, ENHTIM_INT_TIM);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • ENHTIM_INT -- [in] Specify the ENHTIMx interrupt source which to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values, Refer to ENHTIM Interrupts.

    • ENHTIM_INT_TIM: ENHTIM timeout interrupt.

    • ENHTIM_INT_LATCH_CNT_FIFO_FULL: Enhance Timer latch count0 fifo full interrupt source.

    • ENHTIM_INT_LATCH_CNT_FIFO_EMPTY: Enhance Timer latch count0 fifo empty interrupt source.

    • ENHTIM_INT_LATCH_CNT_FIFO_THD: Enhance Timer latch count0 fifo threshold interrupt source.

Returns:

The status of the ENHTIM Interrupts.

  • SET: The specified ENHTIMx interrupt status is set.

  • RESET: The specified ENHTIMx interrupt status is reset.

void ENHTIM_SetMaxCount(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint32_t count)

Set the maximum count value.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    ENHTIM_SetMaxCount(ENH_TIM0, 0x10000);
}

Note

If it needs a dynamic change of MAX_CNT value, MAX_CNT has a minimum value limit. Ex. cpu_clk = 40MHz, ETIMER_CLK = 40MHz, then MAX_CNT should larger than 10. Ex. cpu_clk = 40MHz, ETIMER_CLK = 32kHz, then MAX_CNT should larger than 4. If in the state where ENHTIM is disabled, there is no such limitation.

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • count -- [in] Maximum counter value for user-defined PWM mode (legal value: 0 to (2^{32} - 2)).

void ENHTIM_SetCCValue(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint32_t value)

Set the capture/compare value for the user-define manual mode.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    ENHTIM_SetCCValue(ENH_TIM0, 0x1000);
}

Note

If it needs a dynamic change of CCR value, CCR value has a minimum value limit. Ex. cpu_clk = 40MHz, ETIMER_CLK = 40MHz, then CCR value should larger than 10. Ex. cpu_clk = 40MHz, ETIMER_CLK = 32kHz, then CCR value should larger than 4. If in the state where ENHTIM is disabled, there is no such limitation.

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • value -- [in] User-defined ENHTIM capture/compare value for PWM manual mode, ranging from 0 to 2^31.

FlagStatus ENHTIM_GetFIFOFlagStatus(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint32_t ENHTIM_FLAG)

Get the specified ENHTIM FIFO flag status.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    FlagStatus flag_status = ENHTIM_GetFIFOFlagStatus(ENH_TIM0, ENHTIM_FLAG_LC_FIFO_EMPTY);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Where x can be 0 to 7 to select the ENHTIMx peripheral.

  • ENHTIM_FLAG -- [in] Specify the flag to check. This parameter can be one of the following values, Refer to ENHTIM Flag.

    • ENHTIM_FLAG_LC_FIFO_EMPTY: FIFO empty or not. If SET, LC FIFO is empty.

    • ENHTIM_FLAG_LC_FIFO_FULL: FIFO full or not. If SET, LC FIFO is full.

    • ENHTIM_FLAG_CCR_FIFO_EMPTY: FIFO empty or not. If SET, CCR FIFO is empty.

    • ENHTIM_FLAG_CCR_FIFO_FULL: FIFO full or not. If SET, CCR FIFO is full.

Returns:

The status of ENHTIM Flag.

  • SET: The specified ENHTIM flag is set.

  • RESET: The specified ENHTIM flag is reset.

void ENHTIM_PWMSrcSelect(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, ENHTIMPWMDZRef_TypeDef PWMSrcSel)

ENHTIM PWMP/N Source Select.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    ENHTIM_PWMSrcSelect(ENH_TIM0, ENHTIM_DZ_REF_PWMPN)
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • PWMSrcSel -- [in] PWMP/N reference selection. The actual output waveforms of the P and N in complementary PWM mode. This parameter can be one of the following values, Refer to ENHPWM_Reference_Selection.

    • ENHTIM_DZ_REF_PWMPN: PWM P waveform is PWM_P, PWM N waveform is PWM_N,

    • ENHTIM_DZ_REF_PWMNN: PWM P waveform is PWM_N, PWM N waveform is PWM_N,

    • ENHTIM_DZ_REF_PWMPP: PWM P waveform is PWM_P, PWM N waveform is PWM_P,

    • ENHTIM_DZ_REF_PWMNP: PWM P waveform is PWM_N, PWM N waveform is PWM_P,

void ENHTIM_PWMChangeFreqAndDuty(ENHTIM_TypeDef *ENHTIMx, uint16_t ENHTIM_mode, uint32_t max_count, uint32_t high_count)

Change the specified ENHTIMx PWM frequency and duty cycle.

Example usage 

void enhance_timer_demo(void)
{
    ENHTIM_PWMChangeFreqAndDuty(ENH_TIM0, ENHTIM_MODE_PWM_MANUAL, 1000, 100);
}

Parameters:

  • ENHTIMx -- [in] Select the ENHTIM peripheral. Refer to ENHTIM Declaration.

  • ENHTIM_mode -- [in] This parameter can be ENHTIM_MODE_PWM_MANUAL or ENHTIM_MODE_PWM_AUTO.

  • max_count -- [in] Timer max counter value for user-define mode. This parameter can be 1 ~ 2^32-2

  • high_count -- [in] Timer capture/compare value for user-define manual mode. Timer capture/compare fifo entry for user-define auto mode. This parameter can be 0 ~ 2^32-2
